title: Greedy train-pool D-optimal information selection
formal_object: Legal fixed training pool of design rows x_i, ridge lambda>0, H_S=lambda I+sum_{i in S}x_i x_i^T and fixed selection count k.
assumptions: Rows/selection criterion are training-only; no test labels or hidden annotator access.
Information interpretation requires a linear fixed-noise model; leverage may favor harmful outliers.
Historical first-128 row policy cannot be changed as part of a source-maintenance patch.

operations.input: SPD information matrix plus rank-one row

operations.condition: Finite train pool and declared count
operations.output: Information coverage is not a guaranteed native accuracy gain.

derivation_steps.justification: Matrix determinant lemma with invertible H gives the exact gain.

derivation_steps.statement: At each of k finite steps choose remaining maximal gain, retain ties/indices and update H.
derivation_steps.justification: This is an explicit greedy construction. It is not a claim of the global cardinality-constrained optimum.

derivation_steps.statement: If a high-norm mislabeled row dominates x^T H^-1x, its information gain can be high while task risk worsens.
derivation_steps.justification: Selection depends on design geometry alone; the semantic supervision assumption supplies a distinct falsifier.

method_expression: Conditional finite greedy training-index selector with immutable released-row IDs, tie policy and complete selection cost; do not dispatch or replace the existing row selection without a new accepted design.
distinguishing_prediction: Learning-curve benefit must hold at the same legal row count and include selection cost; geometric coverage and actual label quality can separate.
falsifier: Random/source-stratified selection matches performance, or leverage concentrates harmful outliers and costs more than it saves.
closest_alternative: Known D-optimal design, leverage and coreset selection; no new selector theorem is claimed.
decisive_comparison: Only an authorized new training-selection design, with same original pool/count and complete native scores, can test it; current scope remains fixed.
legacy_code_audit: Historically parked, no I18 implementation; fixed r003 first-128 train policy is retained.
review_limit: Determinant/greedy expression reviewed; task expansion and empirical selection premise remain pending.
